clusters.change: Add one paragraph to 03's opening, for every format in 02 2.1's list: 'Any change to a format's fields bumps its version. A reader refuses a version newer than its own with E-format-newer and the fix hint "install the release that wrote it". The release that bumps a stored format reads the previous version and writes the new one on its next whole-file write (forward-only; read-only consumers such as romeu reading memory entries never rewrite). A record romeu cannot decode is never overwritten: status and doctor report it by id, and salvage --from-host still runs from the tree and the clones into a new record beside it. User-authored formats (project.v1, host-settings.v1) change only by a new version of their version field (see R8-03-7), announced first in the release notes (12 12.6).' Keep 03 3.6's N-1 for the manifest and name its reason there (a cached manifest written before a romeu upgrade, the one window known to be needed now); the event window stays in 13 13.7. No per-format migration table.

clusters.resolution_text: One rule in 03's opening replaces per-format windows: refuse newer with a named id, forward-only migration owned by the release that bumps, undecodable records never overwritten; the manifest keeps N-1 with its stated reason, which answers L11-31's second option. No generic N/N-1 machinery for host formats until a bump needs it.
